title: Editorial Policy
metaDescription: The rules TopProductPick writers follow: accuracy, independence, corrections and disclosure.
lede: These rules apply to every page on the site.

p: We never invent ratings, review counts, prices, availability, test results or first-hand experience.
Brands cannot pay for placement. Affiliate commissions do not affect rankings.
If you spot an error, email us. We fix confirmed errors promptly and update the page date.
